question: Which goddesses are to be known here?
premises: The Bhairava goddesses are to be known.
They belong to the upward tradition.
inference: The Bhairava goddesses of the upward tradition are to be known.
uncertainties: The full list of goddesses is not given in this verse.
plain_english: The Bhairava goddesses of the upward tradition are to be known, O Parvati.
